overview: The Clan Lodge Hall is where Vah Shir clans gather to plan hunts, conduct rites, and strengthen bonds.
history: The lodge hall was one of the first communal structures built in Hunter’s Quarter.
Clan leaders used the hall to coordinate early hunts beyond Shar Vahl.
Ceremonial hearth circles were added to support clan rites.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the hall was expanded with new alcoves and terraces.
Beastwardens began using the hall for pre-hunt briefings and bonding rituals.
hooks: A clan council in the lodge escalates into a ceremonial challenge.
A pre-hunt briefing reveals a new threat in Shadeweaver’s Thicket.
A ritual hearth flare hints at ancestral unrest.
A visiting clan requests aid for a dangerous hunt.
